known_operational_gap.description: CHECKPOINT_PR_TOKEN PAT not set — PRs opened by GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger pull_request workflows. Manual synchronize push required.
known_operational_gap.impact: Each checkpoint PR needs one manual empty-commit push before required checks fire.
known_operational_gap.resolution: Create PAT (repo + workflow scopes), store as CHECKPOINT_PR_TOKEN in GitHub Actions Secrets (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions). No workflow changes needed.
known_operational_gap.no_workflow_alternative: pull_request required checks cannot be satisfied via workflow_run; PAT is the only path that preserves the governance gate and removes the manual step.
